NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2878-80 South Throop Street / 2900-0 South Lyman Street
From RS-3 to B2-2

The Property
The subject property is located in an RS-3 zoning district, on the corner of South Throop Street and South Lyman
Street. The area includes RS-3, RT-4 and B1 through B3 zoning districts and is improved with a mixture of
residential, mixed use residential, and commercial buildings. The vicinity includes buildings constructed to
include ground floor commercial use.

The subject property is improved with a two story mixed-use building (12.0’ approximate height) built in the
1870’s that includes vacant ground floor commercial space that previously included a funeral home for many
years and later a small event space. The second floor includes one residential unit where the Applicants reside
with their young family. There is an attached one-car garage.

The Project
Diane and Andrew Mack (the “Applicants”) seek to legalize ground floor commercial use (approximately 2,000

square feet) to allow uses consistent with those allowed in a B2 zoned districts. The existing second floor unit will
remain. There will be no changes to the building. The existing height and parking will remain.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,875 square feet

Floor Area: 2,728 square feet (No change/ measurement approximate)
Maximum FAR: 0.95 (No change)

Residential Dwelling Units: 1 (No change)

MLA Density: 2,875 square feet (No change)

Height: 12.0’ (No change / measurement approximate)
Automobile Parking: 1 (No change)

Setbacks (existing): Front (Throop): None (No change)

Side (North): 2.32’ (No change)
Side (South): None (No change)
Rear (Alley): None (No change)

A site plan, floor plan, and elevations photos are attached.
As there are no proposed building additions the existing setbacks will remain with no change.
